Welcome to ENDLESS MODE. Your main goal is to process as many messages as possible with as few errors as possible.\r
Verify, Encode, Decode messages. Rules are listed in DAILY ORDERS. You must adhere to these rules unless you want your shift to end prematurely.\r

Every message consists of INPUT and OUTPUT paper. INPUT PAPER must ALWAYS be stamped with ECHO STAMPER. Output paper requires different stamps or signatures, depending on the mission type. Output papers are pulled from two drawers on your left.\n\nIf a message is not authentic: stamp it FALSE ECHO and give it back right away. If a message is authentic, stamp TRUE ECHO, process the message, clip input and output together and give them back.\r
For each successful mission you will earn OPPARKS. The full list is as follows:\n\nAccurate letter: +\r
Letter rewards are added to your mission reward.\r

For minor infractions you will receive citations. You must bring each citation to the table and shred it before progressing. Major infractions or too many citations will result in a court-martial.\n\nEach incorrect letter deducts \r
OPPARK. The full list of deductions is:\n\n\r
If you play against the timer and it runs out, you will be court-martialed afterwards.\r
At any given moment you can press ESC and click on END SHIFT to stop the game and finalize what you have earned so far.\r
